description: Apply - Aeropuerto ESA-BIC <iframe src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/ns.html?id=GTM-WX62QL34" height="0" width="0" style="display:none;visibility:hidden"></iframe> Application process ESA BIC Valencia Region has a Permanent Open Call, for space related start-ups to apply. be part of the future Who can apply Spanish registered companies, located in the Valencia regions of Castellón, Alicante or Valencia. New or existing companies less than 5 years old Demonstrable space connection Viable Business Plan APPLICATION FIELDS Does your business have a space connection? We’re looking for teams, or start ups up to 5 years old, to use space technologies on non-space innovative solutions, or exploit non-space technology in the space market. Our incubated start ups will have wide access to an extensive innovation ecosystem thanks to the support of the Spanish Space Agency, the European Space Agency and all the ESA BIC Valencia Region partners Read the ESABIC Valencia Region Space Connection Assessment (download) The projects may target either upstream or downstream application fields. See some examples here: Downstream application fields Earth observation Satellite communication Mobility Agriculture Energy Robotics/Mechatronics or Materials Environmental monitoring Satellite navigation (road, sea, air) or Mobile services Upstream application fields Launchers Satellites Ground systems Human spaceflight Reply APPLICATION GUIDE How to apply The call for applications is open on an ongoing basis. Selection and evaluation of applications are scheduled periodically with deadlines posted on this website (typically three cut-offs are made per year). 01 Before applying, please contact us for introducing your project and receiving all information about the program. 02 Download and read the Open Call Documents. 03 Submit your project within the deadline using the following link Electronic Office AEROCAS attaching the following documents: Application Form Space Connection Assessment Open Call Template 04 If necessary, you will be asked to submit additional details/clarifications before admission to the Selection Board. 05 If accepted, you will be able to pitch your project and present your company to the Tender Evaluation Board. 06 In case of approval, sign the incubation contract and get ready to work with us!
